+    rows = run_query(query, stream=True)

+        return to_parquet(rows, compression="zstd")
     return to_json(rows)
@@ -71,6 +74,8 @@ def to_csv(rows):
     writer.writeheader()
-    writer.writerows(rows)
+    for chunk in chunked(rows, 5000):

+        flush_buffer()

messages.content: Quarterly infra review, engineering platform. Spend concentrated in three areas this quarter: inference traffic from internal agents (up 34%), cross-region egress from the analytics replica (up 11%), and CI runners left at the June scale-out level after the release crunch ended. The optimizer rollout covered two of the five business units; the remaining three are scheduled after the gateway upgrade. Action items: enable committed-use discounts on the c7g fleet, retire the shadow staging cluster, and re-run the egress audit once the replica moves in-region.
Give me the triage summary: artifact inventory, anything anomalous, and what needs follow-up before merge.
